projects.title: WhatsApp AI Customer Assistant
projects.problem: The team spent hours every day answering the same price and order-status questions on WhatsApp.
projects.solution: Benchmarked four LLM approaches, then built a tool-calling assistant that answers from company knowledge and checks live prices and orders through FastAPI and Azure webhooks.
projects.outcome: 90% less routine manual work, with 100+ customers served

projects.title: Fleet Data Platform
projects.problem: Vessel data for 400+ ships arrived every five minutes, and dashboards took around five seconds to load.
projects.solution: Restructured the FastAPI backend into clean layers, tuned PostgreSQL queries, added caching, and redeployed on AWS behind Docker, Nginx, and rate limiting.
projects.outcome: 97% faster responses, from ~5s to 200ms, with no ingestion crashes

projects.title: Alferd RAG Document Assistant
projects.problem: Teams need trustworthy answers from long PDFs without reading them end to end.
projects.solution: A full-stack app for grounded PDF question answering, with streaming responses, background document processing, load testing, and observability.

projects.title: Burmese–English Translation
projects.problem: Off-the-shelf translation models perform poorly on Burmese, and large models are expensive to adapt.
projects.solution: Fine-tuned Meta’s 1.3B-parameter NLLB model on 12,021 sentence pairs using 4-bit quantization and LoRA on a single low-cost GPU.

testimonials.quote: I’ve had the pleasure of working closely with Min Khant for over three years, and I can confidently say he is one of the most talented and adaptable engineers I’ve ever encountered, especially in building AI-powered web applications for maritime business projects, including satellite communication services for Starlink, OneWeb, and Iridium APNT.

highlights: Built and maintained FastAPI services ingesting five-minute vessel data for more than 400 vessels.
Restructured the backend into controller, service, and repository layers to make features easier to build and test.
Optimized PostgreSQL access and introduced post-RBAC caching, cutting retrieval latency by 97% from roughly 5 seconds to 200 milliseconds.
Deployed hardened services on AWS with Docker, Nginx, rate limiting, and restricted network rules.
Designed and shipped a RAG-powered WhatsApp customer assistant serving more than 100 users.
Benchmarked four LLM approaches on accuracy, latency, maintainability, and hallucination rate before selecting the production stack.
Re-architected the assistant as a tool-calling ReAct agent after diagnosing hallucination and tool-selection failures.
Built FastAPI and Azure webhook automation that reduced the team’s routine manual workload by 90%.

experience.company: Doctoral Institute for Evidence-Based Policy, Inc.
highlights: Benchmarked rule-based minutiae matching, CNN classifiers, and Siamese networks for fingerprint classification, reaching 95% accuracy.
Developed end-to-end BERT workflows for Japanese sentiment analysis, reaching approximately 80% binary accuracy.
Resolved half-width and full-width Unicode inconsistencies across large Japanese datasets.
Built reusable preprocessing and visualization tools and supported production web integration with engineering teams in Japan.
